title: Queue done and the merge guard read test names differently
what: `relay queue done` and the merge guard use one function to decide whether `<file>::<name>` names a test in the file.
why: `relay queue done` accepted a test the merge guard then refused, so the merge stopped after the item was closed and the close had to be reverted and redone (core-tests-not-in-gate, 23 Oct).
failing_case: `relay queue done --test tests/test_ci_hook_tests.py::HookTestsStep::test_quick_runs_the_free_core_tests` passes (lib/relay_queue.py:791 checks only the last `::` part), and `git merge --ff-only` is then refused at plugins/core/hooks/merge.py:149 "closed without a test", because "HookTestsStep::test_quick..." is not literally in the source.
pass_cases: A test name `done` accepts is accepted by the merge guard, and one `done` refuses is refused by both; `<file>::<Class>::<method>` and `<file>::<method>` behave the same in both.
dropped_why: "a" (owner, 23 Oct, choosing: replace the three patch items with one redesign: one record per change, one reader)
